_comment: Allowlist for parity.test.js sub-check 3 (README ↔ code drift). Each entry justifies a deliberate gap between what the parsers accept and what the README's `### Flag reference` table documents. The README table is curated for the parallel/coverage flow; subcommand-specific flags live in their `kmp-test <sub> --help` text instead. Adding a new flag to a parser without a corresponding README row should require either a doc update OR a deliberate allowlist entry with a category here.
